rows.name: Personnel Committee's PROPOSED Classification and Salary Schedule, March 6, 1971: pay by position and step
rows.printed_heading: PROPOSED CLASSIFICATION & SALARY SCHEDULE - March 6, 1971 / Initial | 6 mos | 1 yr ...
rows.what_it_is: Same quantity as 1972 p15/1 (a PROPOSED schedule, rule 1: not a voted or paid rate). Annual dollars for office, administrative and professional posts; hourly (`2.10`, `1.50hr`), weekly (`40wk`) and per-year (`1900yr`) rates for the rest, the unit in the cell. Cells are never summed. Rows under TRADES AND SERVICES print blank for grouped positions (rows 36-37, 39, 41, 44, 46: several titles share one rate line). Rates printed with a unit suffix (`1.50hr`, `1900yr`, `40wk`) are not read as figures: see NEEDS. No total is printed
